general.title: MOSuite - Plot Volcano Summary
general.instructions: Create summary volcano plots for each tested contrast in differential expression analysis results

parameters.name: Significance column names
parameters.description: Comma-separated significance column names, one per contrast. If left blank in the MOSuite function, matching columns are auto-detected by checking for _adjpval first, then _pval, for each fold-change contrast. Example: B-A_adjpval,B-C_adjpval.

parameters.name: Significance threshold
parameters.description: Numeric significance threshold used as the p-value or adjusted p-value cutoff for identifying significant features. Default is 0.05.

parameters.name: Fold change column names
parameters.description: Comma-separated log fold-change column names, one per contrast. If left blank in the MOSuite function, all columns ending in _logFC are auto-detected. Example: B-A_logFC,B-C_logFC.

parameters.name: Fold change threshold
parameters.description: Numeric fold-change cutoff used with the selected fold-change column to classify features. Features meeting both this cutoff and the significance threshold are treated as significant by both criteria.

parameters.name: Label selected features only
parameters.description: If TRUE, label only the features listed in Custom gene list and ignore the automatically selected top features.

parameters.name: Custom gene list
parameters.description: Comma-separated feature names or IDs to include as custom volcano-plot labels. When Label selected features only is FALSE, these labels are added to the automatically selected labels.

parameters.name: Feature ID column name
parameters.description: Column containing feature identifiers, such as gene or protein IDs. If left blank, MOSuite uses the first column of the differential-results table.

parameters.name: Sort output by
parameters.description: How to sort the output dataset and select top automatic labels. Options are 'fold-change', 'p-value', or 't-statistic'.

parameters.name: Additional DEG columns
parameters.description: Additional columns from the DEG analysis to include in the output dataset. Default: FC, logFC, tstat, pval, adjpval.

parameters.name: Point size
parameters.description: Size of the volcano-plot points passed to EnhancedVolcano.

parameters.name: Significance and fold change feature color
parameters.description: Color for features that meet both the p-value or adjusted p-value threshold and the fold-change threshold.

parameters.name: Fold change only threshold color
parameters.description: Color for features that meet only the log fold-change threshold and do not meet the significance threshold.

parameters.name: Significance-only feature color
parameters.description: Color for features that meet the p-value or adjusted p-value threshold but do not meet the fold-change threshold.

parameters.name: Non-significant feature color
parameters.description: Color for features that do not meet either the significance threshold or the fold-change threshold.

parameters.name: Significance threshold line color
parameters.description: Color of the significance cutoff lines drawn on the volcano plot.

parameters.name: Plot title
parameters.description: Title for the volcano plot. The MOSuite default is 'Volcano Plots'; when left at the default, each plot title is derived from the contrast name.

parameters.name: Title font size
parameters.description: Font size for the volcano-plot title.

parameters.name: Use custom axis labels
parameters.description: If TRUE, use the Fold change axis label and Significance axis label values as custom plot column/axis labels. This does not control which genes are labeled.

parameters.name: Fold change axis label
parameters.description: Custom display name for the fold-change column in the plot when Use custom labels is TRUE. Default is 'log2FC'.

parameters.name: Significance axis label
parameters.description: Custom display name for the significance column in the plot when Use custom labels is TRUE. Default is 'p-value'.

parameters.name: Axis tick label size
parameters.description: Font size for the numeric tick labels on the x and y axes.

parameters.name: Axis label size
parameters.description: Font size for the x-axis and y-axis labels.

parameters.name: Use default X-axis limit
parameters.description: If TRUE, let MOSuite choose the x-axis limits from the fold-change data. If FALSE, use X-axis limit.

parameters.name: X-axis limit
parameters.description: Custom x-axis limit used when Use default X-axis limit is FALSE. A single value is applied symmetrically as -value to +value; two comma-separated values are treated as lower and upper limits.

parameters.name: Use default Y-axis limit
parameters.description: If TRUE, let MOSuite choose the y-axis limit from the significance values. If FALSE, use Y-axis limit.

parameters.name: Y-axis limit
parameters.description: Custom upper y-axis limit used when Use default Y-axis limit is FALSE.

parameters.name: Number of features to label
parameters.description: Number of top features or genes to label automatically in the volcano plot after sorting. Default in MOSuite is 20.

parameters.name: Default label color
parameters.description: Color for text labels added to automatically selected feature points.

parameters.name: Custom label color
parameters.description: Color for labels that come from Custom gene list.

parameters.name: Label significant features only
parameters.description: If TRUE, automatic labels are selected only from features that pass both the significance threshold and the fold-change threshold.

parameters.name: Draw label connector lines
parameters.description: If TRUE, draw connector lines from labels to their points and spread labels to reduce overlap.

parameters.name: Label font size
parameters.description: Font size for feature labels in the volcano plot.

parameters.name: Image width (pixels)
parameters.description: Output image width in pixels. Used only when plots are saved to files.

parameters.name: DPI
parameters.description: Dots per inch for saved output images, passed to ggsave. Used only when plots are saved to files.

parameters.name: Plot filename
parameters.description: Filename for saved volcano plot output. When multiple comparisons are saved separately, the comparison name is appended before the file extension.

parameters.name: Image height (pixels)
parameters.description: Output image height in pixels. Used only when plots are saved to files.

parameters.name: Use default grid layout
parameters.description: Set TRUE to use the default grid layout. Default: TRUE.

parameters.name: Number of rows in grid
parameters.description: Number of rows in the grid layout. Default: 1.
